description: This is a Java interface defining data access methods for TaxClass entities within the sales manager application, specifying methods to list and retrieve tax classes by code and store.

classes.name: TaxClassDao
classes.description: Interface for data access operations related to TaxClass entities, extending generic DAO functionalities and adding specific retrieval methods.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of TaxClass objects associated with a given merchant store.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a TaxClass using its unique code.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a TaxClass using its unique code and associated merchant store.
